conviction_note: Q3 is new (no tulosvaroitus since the 2026-06-08 cut; feed read through 2026-10-05) so the scale is a new-numbers day with a live guidance question, set at 6% above this name's ~3.3% observed results-day median because the company has cut growth guidance twice in 12 months (2025-10-08, 2026-06-08) and the ARR guide floor needs +EUR1.8m in H2 after -0.7m in H1; the sign is near a coin flip (p_up 46) because that guidance risk is offset by an 8% smaller headcount in a seasonally high-margin quarter, a net-cash balance sheet with buyback precedent, and a stock already -38% YTD at ~10x EV/EBIT. The findings sum (-0.30) and the scaled number (-0.48) agree in sign and size.

findings.finding: The 2026 ARR guide floor (+3% on EUR37.8m = EUR38.9m) requires ARR to rise ~EUR1.8m (+4.9%) in H2 after it FELL from 37.8m to 37.1m in H1, and the revenue floor (+2%) needs H2 revenue +2.1% y/y against +0.2% in Q2; the CEO said in July that June bankruptcies 'will result in churn in the coming quarters', and the company has cut growth guidance twice in 12 months - so a trim to or below the low end in the Q3 release is a live risk, partly offset by last year's H2 ARR seasonality (+EUR2.1m in H2 2025).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Growth-guide cut by separate warning 2026-06-08: -11.3% next session. 2025-10-08 cut the evening before Q3'25: Q3 day +0.6% (warning absorbed same window). H1 report with reiterated guide but weak ARR (2026-07-08): -6.4%.
findings.original_quote: To our disappointment, in June we received information of multiple bankruptcies which will result in churn in the coming quarters.
findings.why_not_priced: Inderes, the closest reader, writes 'Näkymissä ei pitäisi olla yllätyksiä' ('there should be no surprises in the outlook') and models FY revenue +2.5%, i.e. the market's anchor assumes reiteration. If a cut were priced the stock would have weakened into the print; instead it rose +3.5% over 20 days and Inderes calls the valuation 'erittäin matalalla tasolla'. The ARR arithmetic (H1 decline vs floor) is not stated in any preview found.
findings.independence: Two prior growth-guide cuts in the issuer's own feed: https://view.news.eu.nasdaq.com/view?id=b1b774588ba75a997d20190cf5c9b194a&lang=en&src=listed (2025-10-08) and https://view.news.eu.nasdaq.com/view?id=b3fe95c103b4cbed0963ca2dfb8b3a094&lang=en&src=listed (2026-06-08).

findings.finding: At the 2026-09-15 pre-silent call the company confirmed the remaining Ultima billing-model headwind (EUR0.5-0.9m FY, >0.5m already in Q2) falls in Q3 and that the data-centre construction boom is not yet visible in its customer base; Inderes cut to 9.5 MEUR revenue while the 4-analyst Bloomberg consensus still sits at 9.6, so the published consensus is likely slightly high on the top line.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2'26 revenue +0.2% with billing headwind: -6.4% on the day (mixed with ARR/churn); Q1'26 revenue +3.8%: +3.75%.
findings.original_quote: Q2:lla Ultiman laskutusmallin muutos aiheutti yli 0,5 MEUR vastatuulta liikevaihdon kehitykseen, ja koko vuoden osalta yhtiö on arvioinut vaikutuksen olevan 0,5-0,9 MEUR. Arviomme mukaan loppuosa negatiivisesta vaikutuksesta osuu Q3:lle. (In Q2 the Ultima billing change caused >EUR0.5m headwind; the company estimates 0.5-0.9m for the year; we estimate the remainder hits Q3.)
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: public since 2026-09-16 and in Inderes's number. The residual is the gap between Inderes 9.5 and the Bloomberg 9.6 that other screens show; if fully priced the consensus would have converged.
findings.independence: Inderes Q3 preview table (consensus 9.6 vs Inderes 9.5): https://www.inderes.fi/analyst-comments/admicom-q326-ennakko-heikko-markkinatilanne-painaa-yha-kasvuvauhtia

findings.finding: Headcount fell to 287 at end-June from 313 a year earlier (-8.3%) after change negotiations ended 12 May with 38 departures, so Q3 - seasonally the highest-margin quarter (39.6% adj. EBITDA in Q3'25) - carries a structurally smaller payroll, while Inderes models the margin DOWN to 38.2%; an adj. EBITDA at or above 3.7 MEUR is plausible, though AI external spend and new hires offset part of it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Margin has not moved this stock on its own: Q2'26 adj. EBITDA 31.0% (in guide) did not prevent -6.4%; Q1'26 margin improvement to 28.1% coincided with +3.75%.
findings.original_quote: During the change negotiations, 38 employment relationships ended.
findings.why_not_priced: The Inderes preview explicitly forecasts a lower margin than last year (38.2% vs 39.6%) on AI spend; if the smaller cost base were priced, consensus EBITDA would sit above last year's 3.7 rather than at or below it.
findings.independence: Inderes preview: 'muutosneuvottelujen myötä sopeutettu kulurakenne tukee operatiivista tehokkuutta' https://www.inderes.fi/analyst-comments/admicom-q326-ennakko-heikko-markkinatilanne-painaa-yha-kasvuvauhtia

findings.finding: Admicom holds net cash (net gearing -24.0% at end-June), ran two buybacks in 2026 (EUR2.5m announced 2026-03-02, EUR1.5m announced the evening before Q1 on 2026-04-13) and has bought nothing since April while the stock fell from ~30 to 26.85; Inderes names buyback commentary as a watch item and the shareholder forum is asking why none has come - a new programme with the Q3 release is possible.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2026-04-13 buyback announced the evening before Q1: Q1 day +3.75% (joint with results).
findings.why_not_priced: A buyback has not been announced; Inderes writes 'kommentit ... mahdollisista omien osakkeiden ostoista ovat kiinnostuksen kohteena' (comments on possible buybacks are of interest), i.e. open, not expected. If priced, the stock would not sit at what Inderes calls a very low valuation.

findings.why_not_priced: Macro-to-company transmission; the company's own comment cuts against it, so it is small. Public series, read by the Finnish analyst who discounted it.

baseline_tension: The lean (-0.18, run-up driven) and the +3.5% 20-day run-up are both near flat; my set leans marginally negative on the guidance risk, consistent with neither strongly, so there is little to beat or contradict.
language_note: The Finnish Inderes pre-silent note (2026-09-16) carried the company's own quantification of the Ultima headwind landing in Q3, the 'one-third of ERP customers doing well, two-thirds struggling' split, and the 'no AI churn' statement - none of which is in any English issuer release.

The Finnish Inderes Q3 preview (2026-10-05) carried both the Inderes and the 4-analyst Bloomberg consensus table, the only sourced bar for this print, and the explicit 'Näkymissä ei pitäisi olla yllätyksiä' expectation that guidance is reiterated.

Statistics Finland's Finnish releases gave the construction turnover and sector bankruptcy counts; the issuer's own releases are bilingual and added nothing in Finnish that the English version lacked.
lessons_applied: 'The move is in the guide' (guidance changed: median 9.0% vs 2.3%) and 'too small about the move': abs_move_pct raised from 5.5 to 6.0 since a growth-guide trim is a live possibility on a twice-cut guide.

'A finding about a number the market has already been told is worth 0': the Ultima headwind finding (public since the 2026-09-16 pre-silent call) cut from -0.5 to -0.3; insider buying (public for two months) from +0.2 to +0.1.

'A narrow proxy loses ... macro-to-company transmission is a hypothesis until the company has said it': the company said the opposite, so the Statistics Finland construction finding cut from +0.4 to +0.1.
Margin and buyback findings trimmed 0.5 -> 0.4 each as reaction-not-fact (this stock fell 6.4% in July with margin in guide); p_up moved 47 -> 46.
